context: Mei and Aoi admire a handmade rug.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (詳しい/香り/模様/床/腕) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: この敷物、模様がきれいでしょ?
lines.en: This rug's pattern is pretty, right?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんとだ、床が華やかになるね。
lines.en: It really brightens up the floor.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 手作りなの。私、結構腕がいいのよ。
lines.en: It's handmade. I'm pretty skilled, you know.
lines.style: proud barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: すごい腕だね!作り方、詳しいの?
lines.en: Amazing skill! Are you knowledgeable about how to make it?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、模様の出し方には詳しいよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm well-versed in making patterns.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほのかな香りも、するね。
lines.en: It has a faint scent too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 草木染めだから、自然な香りなの。
lines.en: It's plant-dyed, so it's a natural scent.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 床に敷くの、楽しみだなあ。
lines.en: I'm looking forward to laying it on the floor.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
